_comment: Hand-authored fixture representing the RENDERED Ashby apply-page form fields for the BetterUp Principal Product Manager posting. Ashby's posting-api does NOT expose application questions, so these are what a best-effort Playwright render of the /application page would scrape. System (routine/identity) fields are prefixed with _systemfield_ exactly as Ashby names them. Two custom fields exercise the narrow keep-filter: a compose mission essay (keep) and an office-proximity ValueSelect that reveals working-location + cadence (keep). A visa Boolean must be dropped.

fields.title: BetterUp's mission is to help people everywhere pursue their lives with greater clarity, purpose, and passion. How does this mission resonate with you, and what specifically draws you to this role?
Will you now or in the future require visa sponsorship to work in the United States?
I understand that this role requires me to live within 45 miles of one of the following offices and attend in person at least 2 days per week. Which office are you closest to?
